WITH order_fulfillment_counts AS (
  SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS fulfillment_count
  FROM fulfillments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
qualifying_fulfillments AS (
  SELECT
    o.id AS order_id,
    o.placed_at,
    f.warehouse_id,
    f.shipped_at,
    f.delivered_at
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_fulfillment_counts ofc ON ofc.order_id = o.id AND ofc.fulfillment_count = 1
  JOIN fulfillments f ON f.order_id = o.id
  WHERE o.status = 'fulfilled'
    AND o.placed_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND o.placed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND f.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
    AND f.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
),
order_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    warehouse_id,
    (shipped_at::date - placed_at::date) AS processing_days,
    (delivered_at::date - placed_at::date) AS delivery_days
  FROM qualifying_fulfillments
),
warehouse_agg AS (
  SELECT
    warehouse_id,
    COUNT(*) AS orders_shipped,
    AVG(processing_days) AS avg_processing_days,
    AVG(delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days,
    AVG(CASE WHEN delivery_days <= 5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100 AS pct_within_5_days
  FROM order_metrics
  GROUP BY warehouse_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30
)
SELECT
  w.name AS warehouse_name,
  t.name AS tenant_name,
  wa.orders_shipped,
  ROUND(wa.avg_processing_days, 2) AS avg_processing_days,
  ROUND(wa.avg_delivery_days, 2) AS avg_delivery_days,
  ROUND(wa.pct_within_5_days, 1) AS pct_within_5_days
FROM warehouse_agg wa
JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = wa.warehouse_id
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = w.tenant_id
ORDER BY wa.orders_shipped DESC, w.name ASC
LIMIT 50

note: Warehouses have a single tenant (no cross-tenant sharing in the schema), so warehouse_name alone would be unique, but tenant_name is included as requested for readability. Days are computed as plain calendar-date differences (not fractional/time-of-day), matching DATEDIFF(day, ...) semantics.
